test_title: PYST 13: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - English Language (Held On 25 Jun, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: english
question: What is the good news mentioned here?
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage mentions that** a significant reduction in farm fires in both Punjab and Haryana is heartening news for policymakers and agricultural scientists.**
 
• This reduction in farm fires has led to better winter air quality for the citizens of **North India.**
 
• Thus, the good news referred to in the passage is** the reduction in farm fires over the previous year.**
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1: Reduction in farm fires**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"A significant reduction in farm fires this winter in both Punjab and Haryana is heartening news for policymakers and agriculture scientists at the forefront of combating the scourge."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Reduction in farm fires:** **This option is directly mentioned as the significant reduction in farm fires being heartening news.**
 
• **Sufficient electricity:** This is not mentioned in the context of the passage.
 
• **New policies for farmers:** While there are mentions of policies and efforts to reduce stubble burning, the good news specifically refers to the reduction in farm fires.
 
• **High yielding of crops:** The passage does not discuss crop yield in the context of the good news.
